LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Print awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Print awareness, part of Reading in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do family members wear different types of clothes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. name pictures of clothes worn by family members,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Print awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: Originality as the learner brings picture cut outs on family members, clothes or food from old

books, gazettes or magazines

• Communication and collaboration: Reading learner reads aloud pictures on books, charts and boards on clothes worn by

family members

Values

• Unity is developed as the learner appreciates the role of school uniform as clothes worn in school that make them belong to

the school family.

• Responsibility is enhanced as the learner through role play on washing of clothes learns that can wash own clothes at home.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Citizenship is enhanced as the learner mentions clothes worn by boys and girls and it is emphasized that it is their right to

access clothing as a basic need.

• Health related issues, where the learner becomes aware of the importance of eating a balanced diet as they talk about the

different types of food eaten.

Link to other Learning Areas: Creative activities as learners fix puzzles using broken pictures of clothes worn by family

members.
